key_highlights: ASX limps across weekly finish line higher despite growing headwinds across domestic housing and tech.
Global tech sentiment rattled by leadership turmoil at Nvidia and widespread Microsoft cloud outages.
David Jones shuts 50% of storefronts, confirming acute distress in discretionary retail.
Sharp housing price drops in Brisbane and Perth increase pressure on major bank credit profiles.
AUD currency weakness accelerates, raising imported inflation risks while supporting commodity exporters.

sectors.trend: Buoyant junior exploration and rising global coal demand counter broad macro softening.
sectors.implications: Thermal and coking coal producers (WHC.AX, NHC.AX) benefit from resilient offshore demand; junior gold/polymetallic floats maintain micro-cap risk appetite.

sectors.trend: Mounting mortgage risks from accelerating residential property declines and heightened ASIC regulatory scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Macquarie's penalty and spreading property price falls in Perth/Brisbane threaten mortgage book margins and loan impairment provisions across major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX).

sectors.trend: Severe global headwinds driven by Nvidia C-suite crisis, Microsoft outages, and questioning of AI capex returns.
sectors.implications: Heightened volatility for ASX tech constituents (WTC.AX, XRO.AX, NXT.AX); renewed corporate spending required for domestic digital resilience.

sectors.trend: Structural retail contraction exemplified by David Jones closing half its footprint, despite patchy aggregate spending.
sectors.implications: Severe pressure on discretionary retail operators (PMV.AX, JBH.AX) and retail shopping centre landlord distributions.

sectors.trend: Deteriorating residential and retail valuations compounded by falling state stamp duties and regional price crashes.
sectors.implications: Negative revaluation risk for retail and residential REITs (SCG.AX, VCX.AX, MGR.AX); softening yields as debt refinancing pressures linger.

sectors.trend: Domestic fuel price relief as global crude declines, counterbalanced by persistent gas reservation debates.
sectors.implications: Reduced margins on upstream oil assets but steady cash flows for major integrated producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX, ORG.AX); lower fuel costs provide modest transport relief.

key_themes: AI and megacap tech sentiment crisis spilling over into global equity multiples.
Dual-track Australian economy: resilient commodity exports versus deteriorating domestic balance sheets.
Accelerating residential property correction eroding consumer wealth effect and threatening state revenues.
AUD depreciation amplifying imported cost pressures while insulating resource earnings.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-LVR exposed major banks; favor lenders with diversified corporate and institutional revenue streams.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Tech Capex De-rating & Executive Turbulence
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to speculative high-multiple tech; reallocate toward defensive cash-generative industrial software.
Overweight offshore revenue earners (CSL.AX, BHP.AX) and employ FX hedging on imported inventory lines.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Discretionary Consumer and Retail Tenant Failures
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid exposed retail landlords and consumer durables; pivot toward essential consumer staples (COL.AX, WOW.AX).
Monitor state semi-government bond yield spreads and reduce exposure to state-dependent construction contractors.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Thermal and Metallurgical Coal Producers
opportunities.rationale: Global coal demand growth remains structural, providing robust unhedged cash returns and high dividend yields.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate Defensive Healthcare Exporters Benefiting from Weak AUD
opportunities.rationale: High proportion of offshore US-dollar earnings provides an FX tailwind amid AUD free fall.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Low-Cost Resource Majors
opportunities.rationale: Diversified mining majors offer defensive balance sheets, attractive commodity exposure, and export currency benefits.

defensive_moves.rationale: Housing declines across major capitals and rising arrears threaten Net Interest Margins and credit quality.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Retail REITs and Discretionary Department Store Landlords
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones mass closures signal accelerated tenancy rollbacks, vacancy spikes, and downward rent resets.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Tactical Hedging on Broader ASX Index
defensive_moves.rationale: Global tech vulnerability and limp domestic momentum warrant downside protection on the ASX 200.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 (^AXJO) trading with downside bias as banks and tech face valuation pressures, cushioned only by resources.
market_outlook.long_term: Transition toward cyclical recovery contingent on RBA easing, stabilizing property values, and steady Asian commodity absorption.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statement and interest rate trajectory confirmation.
Nvidia leadership succession resolution and subsequent tech earnings revisions.
Resolution of domestic gas reservation policy framework.
Official Australian Q3/Q4 CPI and employment prints.
State budget updates and credit rating agency reviews (Victoria).
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate threshold at key support levels.
Perth and Brisbane auction clearance rates and median price trajectories.
Thermal coal FOB Newcastle and iron ore CFR Qingdao pricing.
Major bank 90+ day mortgage delinquency ratios.
Australian 10-year Commonwealth Government Bond yields vs State semi-government spreads.
